requirement_rules.condition_description: Per-unit reactances are stated on a base power different from rated_apparent_power.
requirement_rules.engineering_rationale: Needed to convert per-unit reactances to the canonical machine base.
requirement_rules.implementation_note: For REQUIRED_IF: the listed attribute(s) become required when the condition is true.

requirement_rules.condition_description: Per-unit reactances are stated on a base voltage different from rated_voltage.

requirement_rules.condition_description: grounding_configuration = RESISTANCE
requirement_rules.engineering_rationale: Resistance-grounded neutral requires the grounding resistance.
requirement_rules.implementation_note: For REQUIRED_IF: the listed attribute(s) become required when the condition is true.

requirement_rules.condition_description: grounding_configuration = REACTANCE
requirement_rules.engineering_rationale: Reactance-grounded neutral requires the grounding reactance.
requirement_rules.implementation_note: For REQUIRED_IF: the listed attribute(s) become required when the condition is true.

requirement_rules.condition_description: primary_grounding_configuration = RESISTANCE
requirement_rules.engineering_rationale: Primary neutral resistance is required when resistance grounded.
requirement_rules.implementation_note: For REQUIRED_IF: the listed attribute(s) become required when the condition is true.

requirement_rules.condition_description: primary_grounding_configuration = REACTANCE
requirement_rules.engineering_rationale: Primary neutral reactance is required when reactance grounded.
requirement_rules.implementation_note: For REQUIRED_IF: the listed attribute(s) become required when the condition is true.

requirement_rules.condition_description: secondary_grounding_configuration = RESISTANCE
requirement_rules.engineering_rationale: Secondary neutral resistance is required when resistance grounded.
requirement_rules.implementation_note: For REQUIRED_IF: the listed attribute(s) become required when the condition is true.

requirement_rules.condition_description: secondary_grounding_configuration = REACTANCE
requirement_rules.engineering_rationale: Secondary neutral reactance is required when reactance grounded.
requirement_rules.implementation_note: For REQUIRED_IF: the listed attribute(s) become required when the condition is true.

requirement_rules.condition_description: A single-point inrush representation is supplied.
requirement_rules.engineering_rationale: The multiplier and its duration describe one inrush point and should be supplied together.
requirement_rules.implementation_note: For ALL_OR_NONE: if any listed attribute is supplied, all listed attributes must be supplied.

requirement_rules.condition_description: Either short-time withstand field is supplied.
requirement_rules.engineering_rationale: A short-time current rating is meaningful only with its duration.
requirement_rules.implementation_note: For ALL_OR_NONE: if any listed attribute is supplied, all listed attributes must be supplied.

requirement_rules.condition_description: series_rating_applicable = TRUE
requirement_rules.engineering_rationale: Series-rated equipment evaluation needs the upstream/main protective-device relationship.
requirement_rules.implementation_note: For REQUIRED_IF: the listed attribute(s) become required when the condition is true.

requirement_rules.condition_description: trip_unit_type = THERMAL_MAGNETIC
requirement_rules.engineering_rationale: Thermal-magnetic breakers use the fixed trip rating as the long-time current basis.
requirement_rules.implementation_note: For REQUIRED_IF: the listed attribute(s) become required when the condition is true.

requirement_rules.condition_description: trip_unit_type = ELECTRONIC
requirement_rules.engineering_rationale: Electronic-trip modeling needs the sensor basis, long-time pickup, and trip-unit model. rating_plug remains conditional on designs that use one.
requirement_rules.implementation_note: For ALL_OF: every listed attribute is required when the condition is true.

requirement_rules.condition_description: Apparent-power base is needed and is not otherwise imported/derived.
requirement_rules.engineering_rationale: Voltage + full-load current can establish the apparent-power base.
requirement_rules.implementation_note: For ANY_OF: one complete alternative must be satisfied.

requirement_rules.condition_description: Apparent-power base is needed and is not otherwise imported/derived.
requirement_rules.engineering_rationale: Rated active power + efficiency + power factor can establish the apparent-power base.
requirement_rules.implementation_note: For ANY_OF: one complete alternative must be satisfied.

requirement_rules.condition_description: Always for a study-ready static load.
requirement_rules.engineering_rationale: Apparent-power + PF representation.

requirement_rules.implementation_note: For ANY_OF: one complete alternative must be satisfied.

requirement_rules.condition_description: Always, in addition to the required rated_active_power.
requirement_rules.engineering_rationale: Rated active + apparent power determines PF/reactive power.

requirement_rules.condition_description: Always, in addition to the required rated_active_power.

requirement_rules.implementation_note: For ANY_OF: one complete alternative must be satisfied.

requirement_rules.condition_description: connection_type = WYE
requirement_rules.engineering_rationale: A wye-connected bank must identify whether the neutral is solidly grounded, ungrounded, or otherwise not grounded.
requirement_rules.implementation_note: For REQUIRED_IF: the listed attribute(s) become required when the condition is true.

requirement_rules.condition_description: reactor_type = SHUNT
requirement_rules.engineering_rationale: Shunt reactors are conventionally specified by reactive-power rating at rated voltage.
requirement_rules.implementation_note: For REQUIRED_IF: the listed attribute(s) become required when the condition is true.

requirement_rules.condition_description: reactor_type IN {SERIES, CURRENT_LIMITING, FILTER}
requirement_rules.engineering_rationale: Direct impedance representation.
requirement_rules.implementation_note: For ANY_OF: one complete alternative must be satisfied.

requirement_rules.condition_description: reactor_type IN {SERIES, CURRENT_LIMITING, FILTER}
requirement_rules.engineering_rationale: Inductance representation; impedance is frequency-dependent and can be derived when frequency is known.
requirement_rules.implementation_note: For ANY_OF: one complete alternative must be satisfied.

requirement_rules.condition_description: reactor_type = NEUTRAL_GROUNDING
requirement_rules.engineering_rationale: Neutral-grounding reactors are defined by the grounding impedance.
requirement_rules.implementation_note: For REQUIRED_IF: the listed attribute(s) become required when the condition is true.

requirement_rules.condition_description: reactor_type IN {SHUNT, FILTER}
requirement_rules.engineering_rationale: Connection affects network and zero-sequence behavior.
requirement_rules.implementation_note: For REQUIRED_IF: the listed attribute(s) become required when the condition is true.

requirement_rules.engineering_rationale: A bypass short-time current rating is meaningful only with its duration.
